summary: This study aims to investigate the biomechanics of extraocular muscles and the optic nerve in health and disease, with a focus on glaucoma and severe myopia. To achieve this, researchers will use multipositional magnetic resonance imaging, high-speed confocal scanning laser imaging, and optical coherence tomography to study the effects of eye movements on the retina, optic disc, and other parts of the eye in living subjects, as well as precision 3D optical imaging of human eye bank specimens. The study will also develop finite element models to simulate the effects of mechanical strain in the eye during eye movements and explore potential treatments for glaucoma and high myopia.
